Agreement to these Terms

These Terms of Service (“Terms”) govern your access to and use of Evy, including the Evy mobile applications, website, browser version and related services (collectively, the “Service”). The Service is operated by Eshap – Agence de communication Sàrl (“Evy”, “we”, “us” or “our”).

By accessing or using the Service, creating an account, publishing an event or otherwise interacting with Evy, you agree to these Terms and to our Privacy Policy and Community Guidelines. If you do not agree, do not use the Service.

What Evy provides

Evy is a platform for discovering, publishing, saving, sharing and discussing events. Public event information may be browsed without an account. An account is required for interactive features such as publishing events, saving favourites, participating, messaging, commenting, reporting content or managing a profile.

Evy provides the technical platform only. Unless we expressly state otherwise, we are not the organiser, seller, venue, promoter, ticketing provider or contractual party for events published by users.

Eligibility and age

You must have the legal capacity to accept these Terms under the laws applicable to you. If you are a minor, you may only create and use an Evy account with the permission and supervision of a parent or legal guardian. By creating an account, you confirm that you satisfy these requirements.

Accounts and security

Accounts are created using an email address and password. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your credentials and for all activity carried out through your account. You must promptly notify us at info@myevy.app if you suspect unauthorised access.

You may not impersonate another person, create an account using misleading information, sell or transfer your account, automate account creation, or use another person’s account without permission.

Publishing and attending events

Any eligible account holder may publish an event. Publishers and organisers are solely responsible for ensuring that event information is accurate, lawful and up to date, including the date, location, price, ticket link, capacity, accessibility information, safety requirements, age limits, licences and cancellation terms.

Organisers must have all rights, licences, permissions, consents and authorisations necessary to publish the event and any associated images, photographs, videos, logos, trademarks, music, descriptions, promotional materials or links. Where identifiable persons appear in submitted content, the organiser is responsible for obtaining any consent or authorisation required by applicable law.

Organisers must clearly disclose material changes, cancellations and any conditions affecting attendees.

Users decide independently whether to attend an event. You are responsible for reviewing the organiser’s terms, venue rules, ticketing conditions, safety information and suitability of an event before attending.

User content, third-party rights and licence

You are responsible for the content you publish. Evy providing the technical ability to upload or display content does not mean that Evy has verified, approved or obtained rights to that content on your behalf.

We may remove or restrict access to User Content where we reasonably believe it infringes third-party rights, violates these Terms or our Community Guidelines, or where removal is required by applicable law. Where appropriate, we may request additional information before acting on a complaint.

However, copies may remain for a limited period where continued retention is technically necessary for backups, legally required, necessary for security or fraud prevention, reasonably required to investigate reports or disputes, or otherwise permitted under our Privacy Policy and applicable law.

Prohibited conduct

You must not use Evy to:

  • publish false, fraudulent, deceptive, cancelled or non-existent events;
  • harass, threaten, exploit, discriminate against or impersonate others;
  • promote illegal activity, violence, hate, dangerous goods, scams or unauthorised gambling;
  • share sexual exploitation material, non-consensual intimate content or content involving the sexualisation of minors;
  • send spam, manipulate engagement, scrape data, introduce malware or interfere with the Service;
  • collect personal data without a lawful basis or disclose private information without permission;
  • circumvent safety, moderation, access-control or rate-limit measures;
  • infringe copyrights, trademarks, image rights, privacy rights or other third-party rights.

More detailed rules appear in our Community Guidelines.

Evy may use automated systems, including artificial-intelligence-assisted tools, to detect potentially harmful, unlawful or policy-violating content. Automated signals may be reviewed by a human where appropriate. Users may report events, profiles, messages, comments and other content.

We may restrict visibility, remove content, issue warnings, limit features, suspend or terminate accounts, preserve evidence, or report matters to competent authorities when reasonably necessary. This includes content that may infringe copyright, trademarks, image rights, privacy rights or other third-party rights. Moderation is context-dependent and we do not guarantee that every violation will be detected or removed immediately.

You may contact us if you believe a moderation decision was made in error.

Organizer Pro subscriptions

Organizer Pro is an optional monthly, automatically renewing subscription purchased through the App Store or Google Play. The store shows the applicable price, currency, billing period and any store terms before you confirm. The subscription provides recurring events, advanced organizer analytics, analytics export, the Pro organizer badge and professional social links while access is active. Evy AI is not included in Organizer Pro or Organizer Pro Founder V2.

Manage or cancel your subscription in the store account used to purchase it. Cancelling stops future renewal; access normally continues until the paid period ends, subject to any applicable refund or revocation. Refund requests and their handling follow the purchasing store's process and applicable law. Deleting an Evy account does not itself cancel a store subscription. Restore purchases using the original Evy account and the corresponding store account; contact support if a purchase cannot be matched. Purchases do not automatically transfer between Evy accounts.

Organizer Pro Founder provides the same active subscription benefits at its displayed Founder price. The launch program targets 100 official allocations; additional valid store purchases may be admitted as audited overflow with the same paid benefits and qualification rules. A temporary reservation is not a confirmed Founder allocation.

Founder discount eligibility becomes permanent for the same Evy account UUID after 12 consecutive calendar months of verified paid Founder coverage. Standard periods, free periods, uncollected grace or retry periods, and refunded or revoked periods do not independently qualify. Overlapping coverage is not counted twice. A recovered payment can establish continuity retrospectively. Missing or unverified history leaves qualification pending. Ending an unqualified subscription releases its official allocation. Once qualified, Founder discount eligibility survives cancellation and can be used when subscribing again; permanent eligibility does not provide free lifetime Pro access.

We may suspend or terminate access where we reasonably believe that you have violated these Terms, created risk or legal exposure, harmed users or the Service, infringed third-party rights, or where required by law.
